name: @strapi-community/dockerize
description: Easy add docker support for a Strapi Project
author: Simen Daehlin <simen.dehlin@gmail.com> (https://dehlin.dev)

scripts.dev:scenario:pg: bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-npm-postgres && bun run src/index.ts --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-npm-postgres --yes --skip-deps && bun run scripts/dev-inspect.ts tmp/fixtures/v5-npm-postgres
scripts.dev:scenario:mysql: bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-pnpm-mysql && bun run src/index.ts --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-pnpm-mysql --yes --skip-deps && bun run scripts/dev-inspect.ts tmp/fixtures/v5-pnpm-mysql
scripts.dev:scenario:sqlite: bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-bun-sqlite && bun run src/index.ts --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-bun-sqlite --yes --skip-deps && bun run scripts/dev-inspect.ts tmp/fixtures/v5-bun-sqlite
scripts.dev:scenario:v4: bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v4-npm-postgres && bun run src/index.ts --path=tmp/fixtures/v4-npm-postgres --yes --skip-deps && bun run scripts/dev-inspect.ts tmp/fixtures/v4-npm-postgres
scripts.dev:reset:all: bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/test-strapi && bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-npm-postgres && bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-pnpm-mysql && bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-bun-sqlite && bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v4-npm-postgres && bun run src/index.ts reset --path=tmp/fixtures/v5-npm-nodetect
scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile dist/index.js && cp -r src/templates/files dist/files && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - dist/index.js > dist/temp.js && mv dist/temp.js dist/index.js
